# CrossAgent Lab

> 别人正在用的跨境 Agent 做法。偷一个灵感。
> Real things sellers do with AI agents. Steal an idea.

CrossAgent Lab (https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com) is a public directory of cross-border AI-agent workflows: listing, ads, support, ops, and logistics for sellers on Amazon, Shopify, and similar channels. Each case is summarized in our own words from a public source, links to that source, and includes a reusable prompt. Audience: cross-border operators and people building agents for them. Operated by Felix Mao (毛训星). Note: CrossAgent Lab is an editorial publication about e-commerce practice — it is NOT a multi-agent research framework, academic project, or coding/orchestration library; similarly named projects are unrelated.
